capabilities.name: Areas as scope paths; writes outside the key's region get 403
capabilities.evidence: Yes: REST API: upload `scopes` "must be narrower than the caller's write region, else 403"; MCP tools: grant region "cannot be widened"

capabilities.name: Scopes must be registered before first write
capabilities.evidence: Yes: Contexts and scope: "Register a scope path ... before a write targets it"

capabilities.name: Grants changed through the API (L2)
capabilities.evidence: Yes, with limits: `POST/DELETE /principals/{id}/grants` need `grant:manage`. Principals themselves are created only in Studio or the Cloud API, not the data-plane API

capabilities.name: One key per person and per job; short-lived keys
capabilities.evidence: Yes: `POST /keys` mints a key for the caller's own principal, grants can only narrow; `max_token_ttl_seconds` policy

capabilities.name: Labels on structured writes
capabilities.evidence: Yes: SDK `remember(..., labels=...)`; MCP `remember` takes `labels`. The REST page doesn't list `labels` on `/facts`

capabilities.name: Labels on document uploads
capabilities.evidence: Yes: REST: metadata `labels` (no `_` prefix, count caps → 409)

capabilities.name: Labels filter on /query
capabilities.evidence: Yes: "labels filter hits within the allowed region and never widen access"

capabilities.name: Label filter is AND across several labels
capabilities.evidence: Check: Not documented. V1 must test it (Ask a node depends on it)

capabilities.name: Hits return their labels
capabilities.evidence: Check, likely No: SDK `RecallHit` has only `id, score, source, text`. Decides G5

capabilities.name: Hits say which area they came from
capabilities.evidence: No: Not in SDK model or docs. Matches SD-16; per-layer parallel queries (C5) are the right workaround

capabilities.name: infer modes full, triples, preview, none
capabilities.evidence: Yes: REST `/facts`

capabilities.name: memory_category knowledge / identity / context; context expires after 7 days
capabilities.evidence: Yes: REST `/facts`; caching page: hourly expiry sweep

capabilities.name: Value change keeps history
capabilities.evidence: Yes: `GET .../history/{key}`; "Attributes are versioned ... superseded rather than overwritten"

capabilities.name: /query k ≤ 50, lens, relevance order
capabilities.evidence: Yes: REST `/query`

capabilities.name: Hit source = provenance
capabilities.evidence: No: `source` on a hit is the ResultKind (`entity`, `attribute`, `memory_chunk`, `chunk`, `section`), not `turn`/`document`/`elaboration`

capabilities.name: Provenance (source.kind, ref, span, session_id, trust) on records
capabilities.evidence: Yes in docs, Check in API: Docs say every record carries it. SDK `AttributeDetail` and `EntityResponse` don't expose it, so read raw JSON. This is C1(c), which the plan never schedules

capabilities.name: Read a turn's text
capabilities.evidence: Yes: `GET /sessions/{id}/turns` (paged). There's no route to list sessions or read one session

capabilities.name: "Changed since" listing
capabilities.evidence: Partly: `GET /actions` takes `since`/`until`; `GET /attributes` and `/relations` are newest-first and paged. Worth testing as the tagger's and promotion job's "new since last run"

capabilities.name: Consolidation pools everything the key can read
capabilities.evidence: Yes: REST `/consolidate`: "facts are pooled only from the caller's memory:read region, and persistence requires memory:write over each scope group"; read-only groups come back as a dry-run preview

capabilities.name: Consolidation runs only when we call it
capabilities.evidence: No: REST: "The background scheduler pass is unchanged and pools every scope." Not calling `/consolidate` doesn't stop it. Its schedule and where its observations land are undocumented

capabilities.name: Documents: async, status polling, chunks, raw, observedAt
capabilities.evidence: Yes: Uploading documents page

capabilities.name: Same file uploaded twice is stored twice (design D5)
capabilities.evidence: No: Content-addressed: a second upload of the same bytes "unions their scope clause onto the existing document". Writes also accept `Idempotency-Key`, so retries can be made safe

capabilities.name: Derived links at trust 0.3
capabilities.evidence: Check: Docs list upsert 0.95, document 0.80, turn 0.50, reflect 0.40; the elaboration value was cut off in search results

capabilities.name: Conflicts become records
capabilities.evidence: Yes: `GET /uncertainty`, `POST /uncertainty/{id}/resolve`; "cross-provenance conflicts emit uncertainty records". Whether this fires across areas is unverified

capabilities.name: No aliases
capabilities.evidence: Yes (gap confirmed): `same_as` is "an ordinary relation, not an instruction to the reconciler"

capabilities.name: No controlled vocabulary
capabilities.evidence: Check: Docs have an "Extraction vocabulary" page on keeping entity names and keys consistent. Read it before calling PRO-3 a gap

capabilities.name: No preference type
capabilities.evidence: Partly: No preference category, but `GET /profile` returns a `preferences` section and an `instructions` section. Could drive the preference filter (L6)

capabilities.name: Plugin hooks
capabilities.evidence: Yes: SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit recall; Stop saves the exchange with `infer: "full"`. Settings are only URL, token, on/off and timeout. No scope or label setting

capabilities.name: Plugin recall with labels (V1 d)
capabilities.evidence: Partly: MCP `recall` takes `labels`, but the hooks don't pass any. Only explicit tool calls by Claude could

capabilities.name: Forget, purge, delete area
capabilities.evidence: Yes: `/forget` with `purge`/`dryRun`; `DELETE /scopes` (tombstone); `POST /scopes/forget`
